sources.entry: Scap - Screenshot annotation and canvas tool with blur, mosaic, and watermark features. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/Scap/6758053530?platform=mac)

summary.name: Scap
summary.one_liner: Scap is a macOS app for screenshot capture, image annotation, and free-form canvas creation, with blur/mosaic, spotlight, watermark, and OCR features.
use_cases: Annotate screenshots with arrows, shapes, and text
Blur or pixelate sensitive areas in an image
Extract text from a screenshot with OCR
Add a watermark or social badge to images
Create freeform drawings on a blank canvas
Paste and layer images onto a canvas
summary.what_it_does: Scap captures screen areas with crosshair guidance and offers an edit mode for annotating existing photos and screenshots. Its toolbox includes crop, arrow, brush, solid or dashed lines, rectangles, ellipses, numbered markers, blur/mosaic, spotlight, QR code overlay, watermark, and pasted image layers. Recognized OCR text stays editable for cleanup and reuse, and QR codes can be recognized in captured content. A drawing board mode provides a blank canvas, and export or copy-to-clipboard supports precise DPI handling.
notable: Editable OCR text results from screenshots
Localized in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, German, French, Japanese, and Korean
Spotlight, blur/mosaic, and QR code overlay tools
Listed on the Mac App Store
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Platform support is macOS-focused; the App Store link is for the Mac platform
